content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having difficulty setting and viewing negative temperature values on my HMI panel [product_name] 4TP400/KTP700. The readings come from a PT100 sensor connected through the AM2RT2 module. Any help would be appreciated. [user_name]
Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. Please note this is an English-speaking forum, so kindly write future posts in English. Also, avoid posting multiple times for the same issue. Thank you.

Attached is an example showing temperature display and adjustment using a [product_name] KTP400 panel with readings sourced from a [product_name] module. In the automation program, temperature values are scaled with one decimal place. Data exchange between the controller and HMI uses Parameter VM Mapping. For display on the HMI, set the temperature tag data format to 'Integer' and use the I/O field format pattern 's99999', where 's' enables signed values. You did not specify your TIA or LSC software versions; the provided example uses TIA version [version_no] and LSC version [version_no].
Thank you, my software versions are TIA [version_no] BASIC and LSC [version_no].
An upgraded TIA project file for version [version_no] is attached.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced problems displaying negative temperatures received from a PT100 sensor via AM2RT2 module on an HMI panel. Responses emphasized the importance of proper data formatting (signed integer and specific display patterns) to ensure negative values are correctly shown. The main usability concern centers on correctly integrating and presenting sensor data, especially for values below zero, within automation interfaces.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects negative temperature readings from their sensor setup to be displayed accurately on the HMI, without errors due to data handling or format settings.
